enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with air conditioner running to stay cool during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulders. Push blanket down. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Adjust head position. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, brushing teeth, and taking a cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a light breakfast, drinking water to stay hydrated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Eat breakfast. Drink water. Pick up bowl. Place in sink. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, checking work schedule on phone, and packing essentials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Pick up phone. Check work schedule. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place essentials in bag. Close bag. Lift bag.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into work clothes. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, monitoring patients and managing care duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record data. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to nurse station. Review charts. Answer phone. Write notes. Walk to another patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Change bandage. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to break room. Open locker. Take out packed meal. Close locker. Sit at table. Open meal container. Eat meal. Drink water. Close container. Throw away trash. Wipe table. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, continuing patient care and administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient's condition. Adjust bed position. Talk to patient. Walk to nurse station. Use computer. Enter patient data. Print reports. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Walk to patient room. Administer medication. Check IV. Walk to supply room. Pick up supplies. Walk to station. File paperwork. Answer phone. Return to desk.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Walk to door. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Open door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, drinking water to stay hydrated
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add ingredients to pot. Stir with spoon. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Throw away trash. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in bedroom, watching TV and using computer with air conditioner and fan on to stay cool
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open computer. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Put down computer. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off computer. Turn off fan.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Wash hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with air conditioner running to stay cool
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket over shoulders. Push blanket down. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Adjust head position. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.
